description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing code values within a system. It provides endpoints to list, retrieve, create, update, and delete code values associated with a specific code. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for RESTful web service definitions, integrates Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation, and employs Spring annotations for component management. It interacts with service layers for reading code value data and processing commands to modify data, and handles JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: CodeValuesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing code values within the application.

methods.name: retrieveAllCodeValues
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all code values for a specific code ID.

methods.name: retrieveCodeValue
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific code value by ID.

methods.name: createCodeValue
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new code value under a specific code ID.

methods.name: updateCodeValue
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing code value identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteCodeValue
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific code value.
